description: Ex Abu Dhabi Air Force single-seat MB-326KD serial 204, c/n 6572/313, preserved outside the CERT complex of the Higher Colleges of Technology in Abu Dhabi. Photographed there 12 Nov 2007 (Pete Carter) and 8 Aug 2011 (Trevor Bartlett, ABPic caption: preserved outside the CERT complex). No dated evidence found after 2011; presence in 2025-26 unverified and needs a site check. Coordinates are the Abu Dhabi city centroid, not the airframe.
museum_name: CERT Complex, Higher Colleges of Technology Abu Dhabi
